video.title: The Bridge Between Founder Vision and Employee Buy-In

description:
In Season 4 of Invested at Work, host Rodney Bolden goes behind the scenes of the founder journey to explore the intersection of leadership, workplace benefits and human impact. We sit down with industry founders and benefits leaders to discuss how sophisticated total rewards and equity compensation strategies can serve as a catalyst for long-term alignment—not just for the business, but for employees and their families.

Listen and watch on YouTube or your favorite podcasting app: https://mgstn.ly/4vsfLC5.

Visit https://mgstn.ly/4uJvpZB for more insights on workplace financial benefits. 

Invested at Work is brought to you by Morgan Stanley at Work, hosted by Rodney Bolden. Our executive producers are Fiona Kelsey and Lisa Boyce. Our production partner is Sequel Media Inc. 

#investedatworkpodcast #employeebenefits #workplacebenefits #sharemorganstanley
